cases.title: IELTS General Training Official Test Report Form
narrative_blocks: Official Test Report Form issued by IDP Education for candidate Jane Doe.

The candidate completed the IELTS General Training test on August 01, 2025. Results achieved correspond to Canadian Language Benchmark (CLB) level 9 across all tested competencies (Listening: 8.5, Reading: 7.0, Writing: 7.5, Speaking: 7.5).
This official report remains valid for two years from the date of the test administration.

cases.title: Expired CELPIP-General Official Score Report
narrative_blocks: CELPIP-General Official Score Report issued by Paragon Testing Enterprises for John Smith.
Test taken on January 10, 2023. Scores achieved: Listening 9, Reading 8, Writing 8, Speaking 9.
Note: Results expired on January 10, 2025, prior to the submission date of the application.

defect_spec.description: The submitted language test results were taken more than 2 years prior to the e-APR submission date, rendering the test results expired and invalid for immigration assessment.

mutation_details.reason: Test date exceeds the maximum 2-year validity window at e-APR submission

cases.title: IELTS Test Report Form - Verification Failure
narrative_blocks: IELTS Official Test Report Form submitted for candidate Alex Taylor.
Test date recorded as November 01, 2025 with reported overall score band 8.0.
Attempted online verification using TRF Number 00CA000000TAY000X and PIN 00000000 returned no matching candidate record in the IELTS Verification Service database.

defect_spec.description: The TRF number and test verification credentials do not correspond to any registered result in the official test provider system, failing authenticity verification.

mutation_details.verification_result: Record not found in issuing authority central registry

cases.title: TEF Canada Test Result Report - Below Minimum Cutoff
cases.issuing_authority: Le Français des Affaires / CCI Paris Île-de-France
narrative_blocks: Official TEF Canada Score Report issued by CCI Paris Île-de-France for Morgan Lee.
Evaluation completed on June 15, 2025. Individual section scores: Expression orale 310 (CLB 7), Compréhension orale 249 (CLB 7), Compréhension écrite 150 (CLB 5), Expression écrite 225 (CLB 6).
Overall language proficiency evaluation determined to be CLB 5 based on the lowest subscore threshold.

defect_spec.description: One or more individual component test scores (Reading score 150 / CLB 5) fall below the minimum threshold required by the economic immigration stream (CLB 7 minimum per module).

mutation_details.reason: Reading component score failed to meet the required CLB 7 program threshold

cases.title: IELTS Academic Test Report Form - Unapproved Stream
narrative_blocks: Official Test Report Form issued by IDP Education for Sam Jordan.
Candidate completed the IELTS Academic module on September 01, 2025.
The submission contains an Academic stream module rather than the required General Training stream designated for economic immigration programs.

defect_spec.description: Applicant submitted an unapproved test stream (IELTS Academic) instead of the mandatory designated language test (IELTS General Training).

mutation_details.reason: Academic module is not an accepted test stream for Express Entry / economic immigration applications
